findings_resolved: Custom actions exclude paste consumers, credential/settings fields, readers and confirmation dialogs.
Application preference copies cover primary, live, lazy, new and reloaded profiles; config loading is transactional and rejects duplicate normalized keys.
Unfinished draft navigation is restricted; parked ncurses commands retain their original stable buffer identity and cannot execute if that buffer disappeared.
Remaining keys from an action input batch cannot execute against the resulting screen or draft.
Restored drafts require displayed input and fresh activation; ncurses command restoration includes acknowledgement and a separate activation.
The custom HELP path also guards the retained command beneath context help.
Ncurses restored-command display credit requires a usable terminal size; rapid Enter repeats extend the quiet interval.
Ncurses category labels suppress obsolete fixed F-key hints where a user binding overrides them.
The ncurses state fixture now models the first-draw deadline and advances simulated time after display in both private and native test paths.
scope_limits: This is a focused source review of the hotkey feature and its new state tests, not a proof that either entire application has no vulnerabilities.
Native wide curses development headers are unavailable here. The UI agent private state fixture does not test native curses ABI, terminal rendering or real getch delivery.
Final normal and sanitized frontend test execution is owned by the frontend agents and recorded separately; this entry records independent source review only.
